system.description: Once per long rest, when you succeed on a driving roll with your Signature Vehicle, you may move within Far range or clear 1 Stress. Additionally, one adversary makes a Reaction Roll (16). On a failure, it takes 3d10 physical damage and becomes temporarily Vulnerable. On a success, it takes half damage.
